exact_statement: Let X~Ber(p) be independent of arbitrary product-biased bits Y_1,...,Y_n and F=2*1{w X+sum_j Y_j>=t}-1, with arbitrary n>=0, real w>0,t, and all interior biases. With v_i=4q_i(1-q_i), P(S)=fhat_mu(S)^2 in the orthonormal product basis, Delta=I_mu-Var_mu and c=460+80 ln 2, the higher-degree corrected entropy in nats E_ge2=sum_{|S|>=2}P(S)ln(v_S/P(S)) satisfies E_ge2(F)<=(4c+12+4/e)Delta(F); corrected FEI+ in bits satisfies Hplus_mu(F)<=[(4c+16+4/e)/ln 2]Delta(F), with that constant strictly below 3000. Endpoints are contracted. This includes the essential disjoint-composition-prime family 2*1{2X+sum_{j=1}^n Y_j>=3}-1 for every n>=3. For arbitrary two-weight groups, merge identical B slices f_s into probabilities pi_s. Their deficit Gram matrix has diagonal Delta(f_s) and off-diagonal -Cov(f_s,f_u), is PSD, and yields 2 sum_{s<u}pi_s pi_u Cov(f_s,f_u)<=sum_s pi_s^2 Delta(f_s). Mixed spectral B-energy is exactly sum_s pi_s(1-pi_s)I(f_s)<=Delta(F), and Delta(F)=sum_s pi_s Delta(f_s)+[I_A(F)-Var_A(E_B F)] with a nonnegative bracket. Those overlapping energy ledgers do not assert entropy control for arbitrary |A|. The full two-weight, all-prime and full FEI targets remain open.
